aboutHeading: 30 Years Electrical Services in Sunshine West
aboutText: Electrical Commercial Services has been operating in Sunshine West for 30 years, specialising in commercial and industrial electrical solutions. Our team has extensive experience with LED installations, including the energy-efficient systems at Etihad Stadium that significantly reduce costs and adhere to green standards. We combine in-depth technical knowledge with project management excellence to deliver brighter, safer, and smarter spaces for our clients across Melbourne's west.
servicesText: From LED lighting upgrades to full electrical maintenance, we offer comprehensive services tailored to Sunshine West businesses. Our solutions focus on energy efficiency, safety, and reliability, backed by decades of hands-on experience in the field.

services.title: LED Lighting Installations
services.desc: Specialising in energy-efficient LED systems for commercial spaces, including underground parking and stadiums, reducing costs and environmental impact.

services.title: Electrical Maintenance & Repairs
services.desc: Providing regular maintenance and prompt repair services to keep your electrical systems safe, efficient, and compliant with Australian standards.

services.title: Energy Audits & Efficiency Solutions

services.title: Commercial Fit-outs & Wiring

services.title: Safety Inspections & Compliance
services.desc: Performing detailed safety inspections to ensure your electrical installations meet all regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

services.title: Project Management for Electrical Works
services.desc: Overseeing electrical projects from planning to completion, with a focus on timelines, budgets, and quality outcomes for large-scale installations.
